title: marketplace
description: Book, reschedule and cancel appointments at any business on the BookingMaven marketplace.
summary: Book, reschedule and cancel appointments at any business on the BookingMaven marketplace.
offersHint: Book, reschedule and cancel appointments at any business on the BookingMaven marketplace. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.bookingmaven.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_businesses
toolsPreview.description: Search for service businesses by location. Returns businesses with their booking URLs, ratings, and descriptions. Use get_business to see services and get_availability to check open slots.

toolsPreview.name: get_business
toolsPreview.description: Get full details for a business including services (with IDs and prices), staff, and hours. You need service_id and optionally staff_id before calling book_appointment.

toolsPreview.name: get_availability
toolsPreview.description: Get open appointment slots for a business on a specific date. Returns ISO timestamps for each available slot. Use these start_time/end_time values when calling book_appointment.

toolsPreview.name: book_appointment
toolsPreview.description: Reserve an appointment slot at a service business. Provide a unique idempotency_key to safely retry without double-booking. Get service_id from get_business and start_time/end_time from get_availability.

toolsPreview.name: get_booking
toolsPreview.description: Look up the current status/time of a booking you made. Requires the booking_id and the lookup_token that book_appointment returned. No account needed.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_appointment
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a booking you made. Requires booking_id and the lookup_token from book_appointment. Safe to retry (idempotent). No account needed.

toolsPreview.name: reschedule_appointment
toolsPreview.description: Move a booking you made to a new time. Requires booking_id, the lookup_token from book_appointment, and new_start_time/new_end_time (ISO 8601, from get_availability). The new slot is checked for conflicts. No account needed.

toolsPreview.name: create_account
toolsPreview.description: Get a BookingMaven signup link pre-filled with the customer's details. The customer visits the link to set their password and activate their account, which links their past bookings.

toolsPreview.name: start_business_signup
toolsPreview.description: Get a link for a business owner to sign up and list their business on BookingMaven. Returns a URL with optional pre-filled details.

toolsPreview.name: list_my_bookings
toolsPreview.description: List all appointments booked with your email address. Requires signing in (OAuth) — your AI must be connected with an authenticated account that has a verified email. Returns your upcoming and past bookings.

toolsPreview.name: link_account
toolsPreview.description: Link the guest bookings you made with your email to your signed-in account so you can manage them from your account. Requires signing in (OAuth) with a verified email.
